prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a new portrait illustration for a dark Jackie Leven tribute timeline, belonging to an established series.
Input image 1 is the ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH: the sole authority for Jackie Leven's identity, age around 1992, physique, facial proportions, hairstyle, clothes and pose.
Input image 2 is the approved SERIES STYLE REFERENCE only: match its drawn ink language, broad value shapes, broken dry-brush edges and subdued neutral monochrome. Do not borrow its younger man's face, long hair, clothes or composition.

Create one vertical 4:5 illustration, framed from above the hair to the upper thighs, keeping BOTH ARMS and their full gesture visible. Reproduce the original photograph's relaxed, slightly leaning standing pose, shoulder and head angles, and hands tucked in trouser pockets. His right arm (viewer left) descends almost vertically, while his left forearm (viewer right) angles inward to the opposite pocket position as seen in the photograph. Follow the actual photo's anatomy and arm arrangement precisely; do not cross the arms, invent exposed hands or crop the elbows. Dark open-neck shirt with turned-up collar and sleeves rolled above the elbows. Preserve the substantial torso and stocky build; no slimming. Retain the serious direct gaze, full broad facial structure, heavy lids, characteristic nose, lips and jaw and short tousled dark hair of the photograph. Facial likeness takes priority over attractive stylization.

Replace the entire woodland scene with a near-black, barely suggested plaster wall. A few irregular charcoal marks imply an old wall behind the leaning shoulder; no trees, foliage, bark, woodland lighting, bricks with explicit outlines, props, text or recognizable photographic scene. Most of the background is uninterrupted anthracite #0d0f12. The wall is a quiet support for the pose, not a detailed environment.

Make the image clearly drawn and moderately abstract from the outset: bold economical dry-brush ink, muted grey against black, about four broad tonal groups. Simplify facial modelling into coherent calm light/shadow planes while preserving eyes, nose and mouth with precise sparse marks. Hair is grouped into a handful of coarse gestures; arms are broad simple grey shapes with selective hatching. Let the dark shirt and trousers be mostly negative space with a few decisive strokes for collar, sleeves, pockets and folds. No photographic skin detail, fine individual hairs, smooth airbrushing, digital filter, repeating pebbly texture, glossy oil impasto, polygon facets or vector edges. Hand-made broken brush marks and irregular stroke endings, as expressive and reduced as image 2.

Entirely NEUTRAL grey, charcoal and black: remove all sepia/yellow/brown from the photo. Subdued watermark-like presence suitable for a dark webpage; no bright white face or arms. Natural positive light/shadow, not an inverted photograph. Face and arms remain legible. Outer edges and lower thighs dissolve in rough sparse strokes into the dark background, with generous breathing room so the full pose survives webpage placement. No border, title, signature, watermark lettering, logos or additional people.
